No, that is not correct. In Switzerland, you can switch your basic health insurance provider at any time during the year. There is no requirement to cancel your current insurance by a specific date (such as December 31st) for the switch to be valid in the new year. You can switch insurers at any time, and the new insurance will take effect immediately upon the insurer's acceptance of your request, provided you have paid any outstanding premiums with your previous insurer.

However, it is important to note that you must ensure continuous coverage; you cannot have a gap in your insurance. You should also be aware of the notice periods required by your current insurer (usually three months) and confirm with your new insurer when their coverage will begin. Always verify the specific terms with your current and prospective insurers.
